description: Featuring models for every experience level, the Rise Freestyle Scooters deliver a high-quality ride with a stylish look. Whether you want to show off at the skate park or just ride around town, these durable, lightweight scooters can take whatever you throw at them. Designed for beginner all the way to advanced riders, the Rise 110 Team weighs a mere 7.4 lbs and is loaded with outstanding features, including a one-piece welded ultra-lightweight 610 x 610 cm T1 aluminum alloy T-bar handlebar with internal sealed threadless headset, 560 x 122 mm hollow box alloy deck, 110 mm high impact alloy wheels with steel brake, durable ABEC-9 bearings, and quadruple anodized CNC clamp collar and CNC alloy fork. Epic adventures await with a Rise Freestyle Scooter!
